subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers port and prove this watchdog on the current split Control UI chat path, waive proof, or pause this replacement PR while keeping the canonical issue open?
rationale: Automation cannot safely settle the remaining choice because the branch is stale/dirty and the proof gate requires either real browser/gateway evidence or an explicit maintainer waiver for timer-driven session/message delivery behavior.

options.title: Port and prove current-main watchdog

options.title: Pause this replacement
